established_constraints: Monorepo: npm Workspaces (packages/shared + apps/api + apps/web) dengan 1 perintah `npm run dev`
Design Direction (DESIGN.md): 3 Tema Switchable (editing-room, daylight-editorial, creator-tactile) berbeda slicing UI, warna WCAG AA, tipografi, interaksi, dan microcopy; Mode antislop = 1 (DURING)
Frontend: Nuxt 3 / Vue 3 (TypeScript, SPA Studio Mode, Pinia, TanStack Vue Query, Tailwind CSS, typed H3 relative /api proxy)
Backend: Express.js (Node.js v24.18.0, TypeScript) dengan pola Route -> Controller -> Zod -> Service (ServiceResult) -> Repository/Adapter
Database & Queue: SQLite (WAL mode via $queryRawUnsafe PRAGMA) + Prisma ORM (11 model, siap migrasi PostgreSQL) + Persistent Local Job Queue dengan startup zombie-job recovery
Media Engine: Local FFmpeg 8.1.2-full_build & FFprobe via spawn(bin, argsArray, { cwd, shell: false }) + ASS Safe-Zone + HTTP 206 Range video streaming
AI Integration: BYOK Multi-Provider terenkripsi AES-256-GCM (zero plaintext leak di UI/API/log) + auto-chunking audio <=10 menit (~4.8MB) untuk Whisper API
Zero Hardcoded Master Data: 37+ presets dikelola dinamis di tabel master_presets
Testing: Vitest sequential integration (fileParallelism: false) + 1-shot Playwright-core E2E hemat token via Chrome lokal
